build: cargo build --release (default profile, no target-cpu flags)

host.flags: adx avx2 avx512f avx512ifma bmi2 pclmulqdq popcnt
host.caches: L1d cache: 192 KiB (4 instances);L2 cache: 8 MiB (4 instances);L3 cache: 260 MiB (1 instance);

external_tool: PARI/GP [2, 15, 4] (Ubuntu noble pari-gp), single-threaded, elllog timed by getabstime()
isolation: tools/isolated_bench.py run --cpus 3 (1-thread arms) or --cpus 0-3 (4-thread arms); records in raw/isolation.jsonl
amendments: Amendment 1 (PROTOCOL.md, 2026-10-17, before any multi-thread arm ran): the isolation and commands fields above were written at run start; the multi-thread arms ran as parts bsgs3 and rho3 with 3 threads on --cpus 1-3, because tools/isolated_bench.py refuses to reserve every CPU of the 4-vCPU guest.
